targets.blind_problem_declaration:
3-DIMENSIONAL CLOSED-LOOP NETWORK DUALITY:
A 3-dimensional periodic cell complex carries closed 1-dimensional loop
networks. Loops are classified by 3-torus winding vectors and linking numbers.
Discrete Fourier character orthogonality is verified within rational intervals.
targets.continuum_limit_quantity: Relativistic Dirac functional determinant on T^3 x S^1
targets.discrete_carrier: 3D cubic lattice decomposed into 3-simplices on torus T^3
targets.narrowest_defensible_claim: On a 3D periodic torus, 1D meron string loops admit a topological winding parity invariant that cancels negative sign configurations pairwise.
targets.next_test_needed: Formulate the 3D transfer matrix trace solver for L=4^3 lattices to verify cluster decomposition speedups.
targets.title: 3D Spatial Lattices, Meron Strings & Pontryagin 3-Torus T^3
targets.topological_invariant: 1D closed string winding W in Z^3 and linking pairing Lk(c_i, c_j)
targets.what_it_does_not_support: Does not support polynomial-time cluster generation for arbitrary non-Abelian gauge links in 3D without gauge fixing.
targets.what_it_supports: Supports 3-torus character orthogonality and cancellation of odd-winding closed string configurations in 3D staggered lattice models.

targets.blind_problem_declaration:
4-DIMENSIONAL TOPOLOGICAL CHARGE CLUSTERING:
A discrete 4-torus carries topological charges with half-integer second
Chern values. Clusters carrying odd half-integer charge undergo an orientation
reversal that inverts the configuration sign, canceling signed variance.
targets.continuum_limit_quantity: Continuum 4D topological susceptibility and instanton partition sum
targets.discrete_carrier: 4D hypercubic lattice on 4-torus T^4 with topological clusters
targets.narrowest_defensible_claim: In 4D lattice systems with half-instanton excitations, cluster orientation reversal cancels negative fermion determinant signs between half-integer topological sectors.
targets.next_test_needed: Implement a 4D toy lattice SU(2) instanton simulator on an L=2^4 grid to verify cluster sign cancellation in a concrete gauge-fermion setting.
targets.title: 4D Meron Half-Instantons & Second Chern Class Sign Cancellation
targets.topological_invariant: Second Chern class c_2 in (1/2)Z & parity sign sigma = (-1)^(2*c_2)
targets.what_it_does_not_support: Does not support general sign cancellation across arbitrary non-Abelian gauge theories with finite chemical potential where cluster weights become complex.
targets.what_it_supports: Supports pairwise cancellation of half-instanton cluster configurations carrying odd topological charge in 4D lattice models.
